editing: All recorded phone frames remain uncropped and run at original elapsed-time speed. Label bands are outside the source frame. Idle waits between segments are omitted with visible cut cards. Conversion to 30 fps repeats/drops frames without changing event order or speed. Presentation cards are distinct from Android screens. Raw files are unchanged. No redactions or synthetic UI frames are used.
restartScope: Source 05 begins after a force-stop/reopen reported by the root test operator. The restart action itself is not recorded, and a visible card states that limit.
shareScope: Android image share chooser opens with the actual local image and caption. No recipient is selected; no external posting or receiving-app delivery is demonstrated.
packageProvenanceScope: APK identity, non-debuggable status, version code and certificate were separately verified by the root operator. The recorded Android App info visually confirms version name; it does not by itself establish the APK hash or signer.
executionScope: Android 15/API 35 emulator, same DevFridgeWallet AVD and publisher-signed beta.2. Root reports -gpu host. Renderer configuration is not independently demonstrated by phone UI.
notDemonstrated: live Phantom authorization or message signing
